context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup pattern that works reliably: (1) POST /api/leagues with ONLY {name, location, format, description, win_points, points_step, entry_fee, divisions} — the older payload with course_rating/start_date/weeks worked but is out of the schema and relies on Pydantic ignoring extras. (2) GET /api/leagues/{id} returns the FLAT league object (not {league, seasons, rounds, members} — that shape exists elsewhere in the source but the actual handler at line 536 is the flat one). Fetch seasons and members via GET /api/leagues/{id}/seasons and /api/leagues/{id}/members. (3) POST /api/leagues/{id}/rounds needs {season_id, name, date (YYYY-MM-DD str), holes}. (4) PATCH /api/rounds/{id}/status with body {status:'active'} moves a scheduled round into the active section. (5) POST /api/rounds/{id}/cards needs {label:'Card A', player_ids:[<memberId>]} — that's how you flip the sweep-finalize gate. (6) The Clubhouse tab pops a first-time 'Welcome to the Clubhouse' fair-play modal — dismiss with `button:has-text('I Agree')` before further clicks. (7) The scorecard 'League Feed' shortcut testid is `go-to-league-feed-btn` and it does append `?tab=clubhouse`. (8) Rate-limit: don't reload the scorecard more than ~3 times in a row without a 5s pause or Firebase 429s the token refresh loop.
rca of the issue: Iteration-37 P1 (sweep-finalize-btn rendered with 0 cards) was a single missing conjunct in the JSX gate at RoundScorecard.jsx:618. Original: `{isDirector && (`; fixed: `{isDirector && cards.length > 0 && (`. cards is the local state populated from GET /api/rounds/{id}.cards. Verified in source + a screenshot of the empty-state scorecard confirms the pill no longer renders. No backend change needed.
